about.title: ABOUT BLUSTEREAST TATTOO
about.subtitle: Professional custom tattoo studio located in East Denpasar, Bali.
about.storyBody: Blustereast Tattoo Studio was established with a commitment to delivering high-quality custom tattoo art. Every piece is crafted under medical-grade hygiene standards, single-use needles, and internationally certified inks. We believe a tattoo is a lasting personal expression.
about.visionBody: To be a benchmark custom tattoo studio in Bali recognized for line precision, clean workspace, and a safe, comfortable client experience.
about.missionBody:
1. Provide transparent and friendly custom design consultations.
2. Maintain strict hygiene and sterilization protocols without compromise.
3. Educate clients thoroughly on tattoo aftercare.
about.valHygieneDesc: Sterile single-use needles, equipment barrier film, and regular room disinfection.
about.valComfortDesc: Calm atmosphere, beginner-friendly, and fully transparent about the process.
about.valCustomDesc: We don't just copy; we redraft and adapt artwork to fit your body anatomy.
